name: navigation-slide-out-v1
title: Navigation Slide-out v1
description: Fixed 64px header in the ElevenLabs style (14px links in pills with a grey hover fill, white Log in pill, primary pill) plus a round dot-grid menu button on every breakpoint. The button opens a right-side panel that slides in over a dimmed page: big primary links, the CTAs again and small link groups at the bottom.
